en: The postcard features a picturesque alpine scene with a small cluster of buildings, including houses and a chalet-style lodge, nestled by a reflective lake. In the background, a prominent, rugged mountain rises, partially covered with grass and patches of trees. The foreground shows a winding road and fences, suggesting a rural, mountainous region. The sky is clear and blue, indicating a serene, possibly summer day. No visible text is present on the front of the postcard.
